newsitem.title: USA: Circon rejects U.S. Surgical bid.
newsitem.headline: Circon rejects U.S. Surgical bid.

text.p: Circon Corp said its board rejected U.S. Surgical Corp's revised $17 per share bid for all its outstanding shares.
The bid had been revised down from a previous offer of $18 per share.

"We are surprised at U.S. Surgical's latest maneuver," Richard Auhil, Circon chairman said in a statement. "Circon's third quarter performance was an improvement over the second quarter and the year is shaping up the way we expected. The $18 per share offer was inadequate. This latest proposal, like its predecessor, is entirely inadequate."
